dnsd.description: Enable DNS-SD/Bonjour discovery for remote printers

max_wait_time.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for printer status before marking as offline

max_jobs_per_printer.description: Maximum queued jobs per printer queue (0 = unlimited)

remote_printer_expire.description: Time (seconds) after which a remote printer is removed if unreachable

listen_address.description: IP:port to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1:631' or '*:631'). Empty or null = all interfaces

create_queues.description: Create CUPS printer queues automatically for discovered remote printers

default_ppd.description: Default PPD file (or URI) to use when printer provides no driver info

auto_install_fonts.description: Automatically install font packages when a printer requires them

raw_queues.description: Create raw (non-datatype-filtering) queues for printers lacking driver metadata

remove_on_disconnect.description: Automatically remove local printer queues when the remote printer disappears

items.description: Printer URI pattern (substring match) to exclude from discovery

exclude_uris.description: List of URI substrings or patterns to exclude from discovered printer list

items.description: Printer URI pattern (substring match) to force include

always_include_uris.description: List of URIs to always include (whitelist); empty = include all

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections to remote printers

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS validation

tls_client_cert.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (optional)

tls_client_key.description: Path to client private key for mutual TLS (optional)
